rituals.title: THE EFFORT STAIRCASE
rituals.name: THE EFFORT STAIRCASE
rituals.hook: Play: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.hook_internal: Play: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name → Remain Version → Climb Stair
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name → Remain Version → Climb Stair
rituals.goal: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.mission: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.challenge: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.immediate_need: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name — Name five versions of the task from almost easy to genuinely stretching. Effort Staircase — breathe naturally.
2. Cross Out — Remove the zero-effort decoy.
3. Remain Version — Do the smallest remaining version that leaves visible evidence—one paragraph, one call, one plate washed. Effort Staircase — pick action.
4. Climb Stair — Next time, climb only one stair. Effort Staircase — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Climb Stair.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
rituals.formula_flow: Name → Cross Out → Remain Version → Climb Stair
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Reduce the step further if illness, exhaustion, or overload is being ignored.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: MOOD HAS ALIBIS
rituals.name: MOOD HAS ALIBIS
rituals.hook: Spot: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.hook_internal: Spot: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Activity → Add Sentence → Repeat Different
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Choose Activity → Add Sentence → Repeat Different
rituals.goal: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.mission: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.challenge: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.immediate_need: Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Activity — Choose one activity. Mood Has — move slowly.
2. Score Expected — Before it, score expected mood; at the start, Notice actual mood; at the end, score again.
3. Add Sentence — Add one sentence about what changed during the activity. Mood Has — name feeling.
4. Repeat Different — Repeat with three different actions before deciding ‘nothing helps.’. Mood Has — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Repeat Different.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can test what the day does to the feeling.
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Activity → Score Expected → Add Sentence → Repeat Different
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Seek professional support if low mood is severe, persistent, or linked to self-harm thoughts.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: TWO ENGINES
rituals.name: TWO ENGINES
rituals.hook: Imagine: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.hook_internal: Imagine: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Schedule Chosen → Check Both → Drop Demand
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Schedule Chosen → Check Both → Drop Demand
rituals.goal: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.mission: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.challenge: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.immediate_need: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Schedule Chosen — For the next day, schedule one act chosen purely for enjoyment and one chosen for competence. Two Engines — loosen hands.
2. Make Small — Make both small enough to happen.
3. Check Both — After each activity, ask which engine it fed: pleasure or mastery. Rate that one channel only. Two Engines — pick action.
4. Drop Demand — Do not demand that either activity fix everything. Two Engines — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Drop Demand.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
rituals.formula_flow: Schedule Chosen → Make Small → Check Both → Drop Demand
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Rebalance if achievement becomes punishment or pleasure becomes avoidance.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
An urge is a curve pretending to be a command.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Level — Notice its current level and where it moves in the body. Ride Craving — widen gaze.
2. Watch Slope — Watch for slope: rising, flattening, cresting, falling.
3. Imagine Urge — Every thirty seconds, Imagine the next point without acting on the urge. Ride Craving — name feeling.
4. Name Change — When the line changes direction, name the change.
5. Choose Time — Choose what protects the next hour. Ride Craving — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Time.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Temperature can reach body alarm before language does.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Use Cool — Use cool—not painfully cold—water or a wrapped cool pack on the cheeks and around the eyes for a brief interval. Cool Alarm — press feet.
2. Slow — Slow your body while the sensation lands.
3. Remove Name — Remove it, name the room, and reassess the next safe action. Cool Alarm — name sensation.
4. Test Endurance — Cooling is a reset cue, not a test of endurance. Cool Alarm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Test Endurance.

rituals.hook: Spot: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Breathe Pulling → Repeat Comfortable → Breathe Workable
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Breathe Pulling → Repeat Comfortable → Breathe Workable
rituals.goal: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.mission: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.challenge: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.immediate_need: Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urgency & decision pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Breathe Pulling — Breathe in without pulling extra air. Longer Out — move slowly.
2. Let Outflow — Let the outflow last slightly longer, as though fogging a distant window silently.
3. Repeat Comfortable — Repeat only while comfortable; keep shoulders quiet and jaw loose. Longer Out — pick action.
4. Breathe Workable — After several rounds, resume natural breathing and look for one workable decision. Longer Out — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Breathe Workable.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can make urgency leave through a gentler exit.
rituals.formula_flow: Breathe Pulling → Let Outflow → Repeat Comfortable → Breathe Workable
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Return to ordinary breathing immediately if light-headed, air-hungry, or panicky.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: STAY THROUGH RECOVERY
rituals.name: STAY THROUGH RECOVERY
rituals.hook: Imagine: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.hook_internal: Imagine: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Highest → Remain Cue → Follow Learning
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Highest → Remain Cue → Follow Learning
rituals.goal: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.mission: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.challenge: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.immediate_need: The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Highest — During a safe exposure, notice the highest point and the first downward shift. Stay Through — feel support.
2. Stay Past Relief — Do not leave at that first relief.
3. Remain Cue — Remain with the cue through a visible recovery phase—steady gaze, slower movement, reduced urge—then end on purpose. Stay Through — name sensation.
4. Follow Learning — Departure follows learning, not panic. Stay Through — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Follow Learning.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ The nervous system learns more after the peak than at the exit.
rituals.formula_flow: Highest → Stay Past Relief → Remain Cue → Follow Learning
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Leave immediately if circumstances become genuinely unsafe or sense of where you are deteriorates.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Aim: Safety behaviours can hide the safety you are trying to learn.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Safety behaviours can hide the safety you are trying to learn.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Protective — During a manageable exposure, spot one protective act that is unnecessary: gripping, rehearsing, sitting by the exit, checking pulse, carrying reassurance. Remove Invisible — breathe naturally.
2. Drop Legitimate — Drop only that act while keeping legitimate safety intact. Remove Invisible — pick action.
3. Observe Outcome — Observe what the outcome says without it. Remove Invisible — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Outcome.

rituals.hook: Notice: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Smallest → Ask Whether → Let Determine

rituals.goal: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
rituals.mission: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
rituals.challenge: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
rituals.immediate_need: A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A tiny movement may be the body’s unfinished instruction.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Smallest — Notice the smallest spontaneous tendency: sway, curl, stretch, turn, reach. Turn Up — soften shoulders.
2. Pause Enlarge — Enlarge it by only ten percent and pause.
3. Ask Whether — Check if it brings ease, protection, energy, or nothing. Turn Up — notice detail.
4. Let Determine — Let the answer determine whether to continue, reverse, or stop. Turn Up — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Determine.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Say Age — Say the full date, your current age, location, and who is here. Date Stamp — feel support.
2. Name Differences — Name three differences between now and the remembered danger: exits, resources, authority, distance, or choice. Date Stamp — name sensation.
3. State Belongs — Touch one present object while stating, ‘This object belongs to the present.’. Date Stamp — next action.

⚡ FINISH — State Belongs.

rituals.hook: Probe: Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Recurring → Compare Trusted → Picture A Guess

rituals.goal: Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.
rituals.mission: Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.
rituals.challenge: Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.
rituals.immediate_need: Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Self-inquiry works better as disciplined research.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Recurring — Choose a reaction that happens often and remember three times it happened. Study Reaction — hear sound.
2. Read Pattern — For each time, notice the trigger, meaning, body feeling, action, and result.
3. Compare Trusted — Compare the three examples with a trusted idea or guide. Study Reaction — notice detail.
4. Picture A Guess — Picture one idea to test. Do not judge your whole character. Study Reaction — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Picture A Guess.

rituals.title: NO-CONCEPT MINUTE
rituals.name: NO-CONCEPT MINUTE
rituals.hook: Imagine: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.hook_internal: Imagine: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Set Brief → Attend Direct → Let Sensory
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Set Brief → Attend Direct → Let Sensory
rituals.goal: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.mission: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.challenge: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.immediate_need: Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Set Brief — Set a brief interval. No Concept — loosen hands.
2. Name Comparisons — During it, no diagnoses, causes, labels, comparisons, or solutions may be generated.
3. Attend Direct — Attend to direct colour, sound, contact, and movement. No Concept — name sensation.
4. Let Sensory — If a concept appears, acknowledge ‘explanation’ and let the sensory world continue. No Concept — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Sensory.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Reality gets one minute without explanation.
rituals.formula_flow: Set Brief → Name Comparisons → Attend Direct → Let Sensory

rituals.hook: Aim: One ordinary event requires no running review.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Washing → Duration → Rejoin Activity
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Choose Washing → Duration → Rejoin Activity
rituals.goal: One ordinary event requires no running review.
rituals.mission: One ordinary event requires no running review.
rituals.challenge: One ordinary event requires no running review.
rituals.immediate_need: One ordinary event requires no running review.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
One ordinary event requires no running review.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Washing — Choose washing, walking, eating, or dressing. Mute Inner — soften shoulders.
2. Duration — For the duration, omit internal narration and meet only sensation and movement. Mute Inner — name sensation.
3. Rejoin Activity — When commentary resumes, do not answer it; rejoin the activity at the next contact point. Mute Inner — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rejoin Activity.

rituals.name: RUN THE TWO-WORD TASK
rituals.hook: Probe: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.hook_internal: Probe: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Scan Work → Bind Object → Run Command
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Scan Work → Bind Object → Run Command
rituals.goal: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.mission: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.challenge: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.immediate_need: Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Work — Look at the task and choose the single action verb needed for the next minute: read, compare, type, sort, call, or check. Run Two — move slowly.
2. Pick Verb — Choose the exact object receiving that action: paragraph, invoice, shelf, patient Name, pan, or message.
3. Bind Object — Join them into a two-word command such as TYPE SUMMARY or SORT RECEIPTS. Hide every other instruction for now. Run Two — notice detail.
4. Run Command — Run the command for sixty to ninety seconds. Stop only when the verb or object genuinely needs to change. Run Two — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Run Command.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Focus needs one live command, not the whole project shouting at once.
rituals.formula_flow: Scan Work → Pick Verb → Bind Object → Run Command

Another person’s state is information, not automatic duty.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the choice that survives without witnesses.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Nobody — Imagine nobody will see, praise, criticise, repost, or hear about the action. Remove Audience — soften shoulders.
2. Erase Audience — Erase the imagined audience one row at a time.
3. Choose Direct — What would you choose if only direct consequences and values remained?. Remove Audience — split duty.
4. Take Smallest — Take the smallest version privately. Remove Audience — next action.

rituals.title: ASK WHAT THE MEMORY IS STILL BILLING
rituals.name: ASK WHAT THE MEMORY IS STILL BILLING
rituals.ritual_name: ASK WHAT THE MEMORY IS STILL BILLING
rituals.hook: Notice: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.hook_internal: Notice: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.goal: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.mission: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.challenge: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.immediate_need: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rumination & worry loops

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Headline Event — State the event as one factual headline with no motive and no sensory replay. Ask Memory — breathe naturally.
2. Extract Claim — Finish this sentence once: ‘This memory still seems to demand ___.’ Keep only one claim.
3. Route Bill — Route the claim to BOUNDARY, REPAIR, GRIEF, or IMPOSSIBLE REVERSAL. Do not create a fifth category. Ask Memory — notice detail.
4. Act Present — Choose the matching present response: set protection, request safe repair, make room for grief, or stop billing today for a reversal history cannot provide. Ask Memory — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Present.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.formula_flow: Headline Event → Extract Claim → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not contact unsafe people, seek revenge, force reconciliation, or use this game during trauma flooding or immediate danger.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Switch: One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.
rituals.hook_internal: Switch: One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name What Happened → Store → Use After

rituals.goal: One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.
rituals.mission: One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.
rituals.challenge: One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
One miss should trigger recovery, not identity collapse.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name What Happened — Pre-plan three actions after a lapse: name what happened without judgement; restore the environment or schedule; perform the next smallest valid repetition. Lapse Fire — widen gaze.
2. Store — Store the script beside the behaviour. Lapse Fire — split duty.
3. Use After — Use it after one miss—before a second is negotiated. Lapse Fire — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Use After.

rituals.hook: Catch: Empathy does not sign their conclusion.

items.hook: Play: Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

items.game_move: PLAY: Name → Remain Version → Climb Stair

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name — Name five versions of the task from almost easy to genuinely stretching. Effort Staircase — breathe naturally.
2. Cross Out — Remove the zero-effort decoy.
3. Remain Version — Do the smallest remaining version that leaves visible evidence—one paragraph, one call, one plate washed. Effort Staircase — pick action.
4. Climb Stair — Next time, climb only one stair. Effort Staircase — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Climb Stair.

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

GOAL
Start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

1. Name — Name five versions of the task from almost easy to genuinely stretching. Effort Staircase — breathe naturally.
2. Cross Out — Remove the zero-effort decoy.
3. Remain Version — Do the smallest remaining version that leaves visible evidence—one paragraph, one call, one plate washed. Effort Staircase — pick action.
4. Climb Stair — Next time, climb only one stair. Effort Staircase — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Climb Stair.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can start where movement is possible, not where pride prefers.

FORMULA FLOW
Name → Cross Out → Remain Version → Climb Stair

items.name: TWO ENGINES
items.hook: Imagine: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.hook_internal: Imagine: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.game_move: PLAY: Schedule Chosen → Check Both → Drop Demand
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Schedule Chosen → Check Both → Drop Demand
items.goal: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.mission: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.challenge: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.immediate_need: Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Schedule Chosen — For the next day, schedule one act chosen purely for enjoyment and one chosen for competence. Two Engines — loosen hands.
2. Make Small — Make both small enough to happen.
3. Check Both — After each activity, ask which engine it fed: pleasure or mastery. Rate that one channel only. Two Engines — pick action.
4. Drop Demand — Do not demand that either activity fix everything. Two Engines — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Drop Demand.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Pleasure and mastery refuel different parts of you.

items.challenge: Your environment casts ballots before willpower arrives.
items.immediate_need: Your environment casts ballots before willpower arrives.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Your environment casts ballots before willpower arrives.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Desired — Pick one desired behaviour and one unwanted default. Make Room — widen gaze.
2. Place Object — Place the first object needed for the desired action directly in your path.
3. Add Deliberate — Add one deliberate obstacle to the unwanted route: distance, logout, container, timer, or removal. Make Room — pick action.
4. Let Room — Let the room make the better vote easier. Make Room — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Room.

GOAL

1. Name Cue — Name the cue and the usual calming act it normally summons. Let Urge — soften shoulders.
2. Contact — Contact only a tolerable dose of the cue.
3. Keep Hands — Keep your hands and attention out of the ritual while the urge changes on its own. Let Urge — name feeling.
4. Mark Peak — Hold the peak and the first natural drop.
5. Learning — Learning happens in the missed appointment. Let Urge — next action.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
An urge is a curve pretending to be a command.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Level — Notice its current level and where it moves in the body. Ride Craving — widen gaze.
2. Watch Slope — Watch for slope: rising, flattening, cresting, falling.
3. Imagine Urge — Every thirty seconds, Imagine the next point without acting on the urge. Ride Craving — name feeling.
4. Name Change — When the line changes direction, name the change.
5. Choose Time — Choose what protects the next hour. Ride Craving — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Time.

GOAL

items.play_the_loop:
1. Highest — During a safe exposure, notice the highest point and the first downward shift. Stay Through — feel support.
2. Stay Past Relief — Do not leave at that first relief.
3. Remain Cue — Remain with the cue through a visible recovery phase—steady gaze, slower movement, reduced urge—then end on purpose. Stay Through — name sensation.
4. Follow Learning — Departure follows learning, not panic. Stay Through — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Follow Learning.

items.goal: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.mission: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.challenge: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.immediate_need: Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give the nervous system evidence that time has moved.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Say Age — Say the full date, your current age, location, and who is here. Date Stamp — feel support.
2. Name Differences — Name three differences between now and the remembered danger: exits, resources, authority, distance, or choice. Date Stamp — name sensation.
3. State Belongs — Touch one present object while stating, ‘This object belongs to the present.’. Date Stamp — next action.

⚡ FINISH — State Belongs.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Emotion — Notice where their emotion seems to enter your body. Emotion Stops — breathe naturally.
2. Trace Physical — Trace your physical boundary with gaze or touch.
3. State Action — State what action is yours, what remains theirs, and what you can offer without taking ownership. Emotion Stops — split duty.
4. Stay Blurred — Adjust distance if the distinction stays blurred. Emotion Stops — next action.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the choice that survives without witnesses.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Nobody — Imagine nobody will see, praise, criticise, repost, or hear about the action. Remove Audience — soften shoulders.
2. Erase Audience — Erase the imagined audience one row at a time.
3. Choose Direct — What would you choose if only direct consequences and values remained?. Remove Audience — split duty.
4. Take Smallest — Take the smallest version privately. Remove Audience — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Take Smallest.

items.name: ASK WHAT THE MEMORY IS STILL BILLING
items.ritual_name: ASK WHAT THE MEMORY IS STILL BILLING
items.hook: Notice: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.hook_internal: Notice: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.game_move: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
items.goal: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.mission: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.challenge: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.immediate_need: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rumination & worry loops

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Headline Event — State the event as one factual headline with no motive and no sensory replay. Ask Memory — breathe naturally.
2. Extract Claim — Finish this sentence once: ‘This memory still seems to demand ___.’ Keep only one claim.
3. Route Bill — Route the claim to BOUNDARY, REPAIR, GRIEF, or IMPOSSIBLE REVERSAL. Do not create a fifth category. Ask Memory — notice detail.
4. Act Present — Choose the matching present response: set protection, request safe repair, make room for grief, or stop billing today for a reversal history cannot provide. Ask Memory — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Present.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
items.formula_flow: Headline Event → Extract Claim → Route Bill → Act Present
items.safety:
PAUSE
Do not contact unsafe people, seek revenge, force reconciliation, or use this game during trauma flooding or immediate danger.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL

items.play_the_loop:
1. Question Demands — When the question demands an answer, Picture it and delay asking for a short, chosen interval. Unanswered Urge — breathe naturally.
2. Track Urge — Track urge intensity at beginning, middle, and end without researching. Unanswered Urge — allow opposite.
3. Decide Afterward — Decide afterward whether information is still needed for action or only for relief. Unanswered Urge — next action.

items.plain:
THE UNANSWERED URGE EXPERIMENT

TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

GOAL
Reassurance can wait while its appetite changes.

1. Question Demands — When the question demands an answer, Picture it and delay asking for a short, chosen interval. Unanswered Urge — breathe naturally.
2. Track Urge — Track urge intensity at beginning, middle, and end without researching. Unanswered Urge — allow opposite.
3. Decide Afterward — Decide afterward whether information is still needed for action or only for relief. Unanswered Urge — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Decide Afterward.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Reassurance can wait while its appetite changes.

FORMULA FLOW
Question Demands → Track Urge → Decide Afterward

items.name: THIS IS A CHAPTER, NOT THE BOOK
items.ritual_name: THIS IS A CHAPTER, NOT THE BOOK
items.hook: Look: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.hook_internal: Look: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.game_move: PLAY: Place Today → Picture Future → Choose Sentence
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Place Today → Picture Future → Choose Sentence
items.goal: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.mission: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.challenge: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.immediate_need: The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The present cannot forecast unopened pages.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Place Today — Position today’s event on a long timeline with past chapters already survived and blank space ahead. Chapter Book — move slowly.
2. Picture Future — Picture three future signposts that remain possible but unknown. Chapter Book — allow opposite.
3. Choose Sentence — Choose one sentence describing this chapter accurately without making it the title of the whole life. Chapter Book — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Sentence.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I just caught the moment before it became the whole room.
items.formula_flow: Place Today → Picture Future → Choose Sentence

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

items.play_the_loop:
